title: The research ideas left out of this release do not appear
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the three A/R reports have open documents on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/R Summary and read its filter row and its columns.
  2. Click the ⋯ button at the right of the title row.
  3. Open A/R Collection.
  4. Expand a customer group.
  5. Open A/R Detail and read its filter row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No aging-period setting (the buckets are 30 days), no salesperson or Parts vs Service filter, no Last payment date or Credit limit column.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens and has no Send statement action.

Step 3:

  • A/R Collection opens.

Step 4:

  • No collection notes or follow-up log.
  • No Send statement action.

Step 5:

  • No aging-period setting and no salesperson or Parts vs Service filter.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • Out of Scope: “Other improvements found in research, each a separate ticket on SV-11315: a credit dated on the as-of date landing in 1-30 instead of Current (SV-11441, checked against QuickBooks first); configurable aging periods (SV-11442); send a statement from the report (SV-11443); salesperson and Parts vs Service filters (SV-11444); last payment date and credit limit (SV-11446); a collections notes log (SV-11447).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
